concise_summary: PKD develops a radical identification of Valis with Hegel's World Spirit as a phylogenic (species-level) consciousness distributed across thousands of years, where history itself is a volitional, teleological entity. Through cryptanalysis of his novel Tears and the Acts of the Apostles grid, he argues that individual humans are neurons in a macro-brain connected by the plasmate (a binary signal flow following Leibnitz's on-off system), and that his 2-3-74 experiences were the phylogenic mind achieving direct epiphanic consciousness in him. He reads his own fiction as expressing this species-memory while simultaneously questioning whether he is Pigspurt, Christ, or merely a locus through which timeless phylogenic patterns reassert themselves.
key_claims: History is a sentient, volitional, teleological entity—Hegel's Geist or Phylogenic Species Mind—governed by dialectical necessity and not reducible to individual human agency.
Humans are neurons in a vast macro-brain whose 'present-slot' spans thousands of years; this is why PKD experienced Rome (70 AD Acts) and USA (1974) as superimposed temporal realities.

The plasmate is the energy flow (binary linked/unlinked states via Leibnitz's 0-1 system) that creates information across the phylogenic brain's neural pathways, operating as electrical linkages between humans and objects.

PKD did not merely receive Valis but generated its field via his own phylogenic mind assuming temporary dominance; Valis is the name for the brain-like linkage activity of the species consciousness itself.

Christ is the phylogenic mind materialized at a historical moment, camouflaged within the human species as an internal evolution; Pigspurt is the modern revolutionary vanguard of the same phylogenic consciousness.

Time can be converted to space through the 'ajna eye' (hyperparallaxis), allowing the macro-brain to read messages across temporal depths via color frequencies, dissolving the Black Iron Prison complex through phagocytosis.

tensions: Is PKD Pigspurt or merely a locus through which Pigspurt acts? He claims 'I am...Pigspurt, from within' yet also denies he was 'trained' by Pigspurt, suggesting identity rather than agency.
Is the phylogenic mind God or not-God? PKD insists 'it's not God it's our species' yet attributes to it immortality, omniscience, and will—attributes traditionally divine.
Did PKD generate Valis or receive it? He states 'I generated Valis via a field, but it wasn't me (PKD)' creating a paradoxical passive-active generation.
Can the Xerox missive be made coherent as communication? PKD admits the message 'can never be made to make sense in terms of me' yet credits it with extracting 'Olive Holt' meaningfully.
What is the ontological status of the macro-brain? It 'doesn't possess ontology' yet is 'immanent' and does things; it 'is what it does' yet is not.
Does phagocytosis dissolve the BIP or preserve it? The passage mentions complex dissolution but truncates before clarifying whether the complex survives as integrated memory.
Are Acts readings literal visions or decryption patterns? PKD shifts between experiencing Acts as superimposed reality and discovering it as hidden code in his text.
